artworks.title: The Times
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting allegorical figures engaged in a complex interaction. In the center, a person symbolizing a governing or royal figure is seated on a throne, gesturing outward with a dramatic pose. Flanking this central figure are various allegorical characters such as Liberty holding a pole with a "Liberty" hat and a figure resembling Justice holding scales and a sword. These figures are surrounded by objects and symbols like the British flag, a shield with a cross, and a lion, representing virtues and national identity like "Virtue," "Patriotism," "Public Safety," and the "Voice of the People." Other figures portray trade or commerce, as well as sinister characters suggesting rebellion and chaos. The composition features detailed linework and vivid colors, creating a satirical and political narrative reminiscent of caricature. This painting is in the style of James Gillray, a artist known for his satirical political art in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.

artworks.title: The Poll
artworks.medium: etching and stipple with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seesaw with figures riding it in a public setting. The scene shows two elegantly dressed individuals in an exaggerated and whimsical manner, wearing 18th-century attire. One figure is airborne with arms outstretched, while others in vibrant clothing are seen either assisting or balancing on the seesaw. The background features a bustling crowd against a grand architectural setting, with expressions of surprise and amusement. The composition uses vivid colors and a caricatured style to emphasize playful dynamism and social interaction.

artworks.title: Manager and Spouter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a room. One man in a pink coat gestures excitedly with his hat in his hand. A woman in a brown dress with blue stripes carries a tray with a teapot and cups. Another man is seated at a table looking towards them. The room includes a fireplace with a decorative mantelpiece, paintings on the wall, and a white animal resembling a cat sitting on the floor near the table. The color palette is muted, with delicate line work and watercolor shades.

artworks.title: Bookseller and Author
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene in a bookstore or library. The scene portrays an interior filled with shelves stocked with books. In the foreground, piles of books are stacked on a table while others are opened. The setting conveys a space dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge, with a rich, detailed backdrop capturing the essence of an 18th-century study area or bookshop. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Resurrection, or The Frighted Nurse
artworks.description: There are two figures in an indoor scene. On the left, an older male is emerging from a vertically positioned rectangular box with a startled expression. On the right, a nurse is seated at a table, with a concerned expression. She leans forward with one arm on an open book and the other holding a candlestick. The background includes draped curtains, an ornate chair, a large window with leaded glass, and detailed moldings. Objects on the floor near the nurse include a teacup and a small blue bottle.

artworks.title: Two Strings to Your Bow
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated side by side, depicted from head to toe. The person on the left is sitting casually with their legs crossed, their body slightly angled towards the person in the center. They have a prominent facial structure with pronounced cheeks and a high forehead, with their hair styled in a voluminous, white, curly manner. They wear an orange-brown jacket over a patterned waistcoat, cream-colored knee breeches, and long white stockings, with pointed dark shoes. The person in the middle, a woman, is facing the viewer directly, with an elaborate, tall white hairdo atop her head. She wears an ornate yellow gown with a large white collar and sleeves. The gentleman on the right sits with legs extended, wearing a white wig, and his face shows a round nose and a toothy grin. His outfit consists of a bright blue coat with pink cuffs and a white waistcoat, along with yellow breeches and white stockings. He is leaning slightly to his left, toward the woman in the center. Their chairs are upholstered in a bold pink fabric with wooden frames. The background is a simple, textured pale blue-gray, indicating an indoor setting with minimal decoration.

artworks.title: The Wonderful Pig
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a pig performing a trick for an audience. It depicts a group of people watching the pig interacting with cards on the floor. The detailed image shows the varied facial expressions of the audience members. There is text at the top of the image suggesting the pig has a unique ability, possibly related to languages. The drawing captures a moment of entertainment in a satirical style, with lines and cross-hatching used to emphasize the humor.

artworks.title: Comfort in the Gout
artworks.description: This is a painting of a domestic scene with several people engaged in caregiving activities. An overweight man sits in a high-backed green chair, wearing a red vest and blue knee breeches. His left leg is elevated on a footrest and bandaged. Surrounding him are individuals attending to his needs. One person offers a drink, another holds a tray with utensils, and in the background more characters prepare a meal, with a soup tureen being carried. A dog and a cat are resting on the floor nearby. The room is rich with period details, including draped fabric, patterned clothing, and lavishly set tables. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: A Bawd on Her Last Legs
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals. The primary figure is reclining in a large chair, dressed in a long-sleeved gown and wearing a bonnet. Another person is leaning over the chair, with curly hair and a bonnet, wearing a light dress with trim. A third person is partially kneeling to the right, holding a candlestick with a lit candle. The background features a fine pattern.

artworks.title: A Bawd on Her Last Legs
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals: an elderly woman, a younger woman, and an older man. The elderly woman is seated in an armchair, with her full body visible, wearing a pink dress with puffed sleeves and a bonnet. Her facial expression is weary, eyes slightly closed, and she is resting her head back on the chair. The younger woman is standing beside the chair, her upper body visible, bending slightly forward toward the seated woman. She has loose curly blonde hair, adorned with a ribbon and a white bonnet. She wears a yellow dress with lace details and holds a lit candle on a brass holder. The older man is seated on the floor, his full body visible, leaning forward with closed eyes and holding his face. He is dressed in a light blue coat with white lace trimming and holds a hat and a walking stick. The scene is set against a textured, abstract background with muted tones of gray and green. The artist's signature and the date "1792" appear in the lower left corner, and below the image is the title "A Bawd on Her Last Legs."

artworks.title: Vauxhall Gardens
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor social gathering at Vauxhall Gardens. The scene features formally dressed individuals congregating under trees. In the left part, there is a two-tiered pavilion with arches and balustrades, where musicians are playing. A figure is on one of the balconies watching the crowd below, who are interacting, walking, and enjoying refreshments. Lanterns hang from the trees, illuminating the garden. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: The Consultation
artworks.description: The image depicts six men standing closely together. They wear white wigs, long coats, waistcoats, white stockings, and dark shoes. Some face each other while others face the viewer. The men hold objects like a walking cane and a fan. The background is plain, and a decorative border frames the scene. The title "THE CONSULTATION" is shown beneath the scene.

artworks.title: The Sad Discovery, or The Graceless Apprentice
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a bedroom. In the image, several figures are gathered around a bed, reacting with surprise and alarm. The bedding is in disarray, and one figure is crawling on the floor while others are gesturing with expressions of shock. A canopy is over the bed. The characters' expressions and postures are exaggerated, and the room is dimly lit with shadows.

artworks.title: A Cully Pillaged
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene inside a domestic setting. Two men and a woman are depicted in a dramatic moment. One man is grasping the lapels of another, while the woman sits slumped to the side. The room is detailed with diamond-paned windows and an open door. There is a large jug on the floor beside a hat, emphasizing the lived-in aspect of the room.

artworks.title: A Bed-warmer
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a bed, leaning forward and looking at a standing woman. The man wears loose clothing and has his hair pulled back. The woman is holding a lit candle and a frying pan, wearing a long dress and a headpiece. They are in a dimly-lit room with a canopy bed, scattered clothing items, and a chair.

artworks.title: Rustic Courtship
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a rustic outdoor setting. The man is standing with one hand on his head, facing the woman. He has a broad smile, shoulder-length dark hair, and is dressed in an earthy red coat, light blue waistcoat, yellow breeches, blue stockings, and black shoes. The woman is seated on a chair, spinning using a wheel in front of her. She has dark hair, wears a white bonnet, and a white dress with long sleeves. Surrounding them are a barrel, a broom against the wall, a tree with green foliage, a simple wooden house with a thatched roof, and an earthy ground with grassy patches.

artworks.title: The Reconciliation, or The Return from Scotland
artworks.description: This is a painting of a domestic scene. The scene shows several characters interacting in a parlor. The figures are dressed in period clothing. In the center, a figure in elaborate attire appears to be conversing with another figure, possibly a woman. To the right, two more characters are engaged in the situation; one is seated while the other gestures with curiosity or surprise. A small dog stands on its hind legs against a chair. The figures' expressions and postures suggest animated dialogue or a dramatic moment. The furniture and surroundings create a genteel indoor setting. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his depictions of 18th-century British society.

artworks.title: The Supplemental Magazine
artworks.description: The image shows a group of women in elaborate clothing and hats, with cartoonish features. Their dresses are detailed with frills and lace, and some women are posing in different positions. A small dog is also depicted among the group. In the background, there are faint outlines of feathers on the hats, a mirror, and the text "THE SUPPLEMENTAL MAGAZINE" at the bottom.

artworks.title: A Militia Meeting
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of men in an ornate room engaged in discussion and reviewing a large map. The scene depicts several men gathered around a table in a richly decorated interior. One man, seated in an armchair, is studying a map presented by an attendant who is rolling it out on the floor. The room is furnished with chairs, a table set with glassware, and the back wall is adorned with crossed swords and firearms above the fireplace. The atmosphere suggests a sense of deliberation or planning.

artworks.title: The Bachelor
artworks.description: The image shows three people and a dog. The central figure is a man seated in a large armchair. He is reclined back with a relaxed posture, hands clasped in front of him. He appears to be an older man with curly gray hair, dressed in a long robe. Nearby, another man with white hair styled in curls sits facing him in a chair, holding a pipe. A woman sits on the table, wearing a bonnet and dress, holding a bottle and a lazy bird ornament. A small black dog is seated on the floor next to them. The room they are in appears intimate, with a billowing blue curtain serving as a backdrop. A fireplace with kitchen utensils, framed papers on the mantle, and a cane or poker nearby are also visible.

artworks.title: The Married Man
artworks.description: The image shows a domestic scene with four adults and two children. In the center, a man is seated in a chair with one leg crossed over the other engaging with a child on his lap. He has curled hair, a pronounced facial profile, and is dressed in a blue coat over a white shirt and trousers, holding a small object, possibly a glass. To his right, a woman leans over touching the child, wearing a blue dress with a light-colored apron and a cap on her head. Another woman is seated beside her, wearing a long, ornate dress with a shawl over her shoulders and holding another child on her lap. A lute rests against her chair, and an open window with curtains drawn back is visible behind her. A small table with a bottle, cup, and glass is in front of the man, and a dog sits on the floor looking up at him. The room contains ornate furnishings, a large picture on the wall, and architectural details like a fireplace mantel.

artworks.title: Racing
artworks.description: The image shows a horse racing scene from an elevated point of view. The landscape shows hills meeting the sky with trees and a red building in the distance. Multiple jockeys on horseback are racing on a dirt track, with other horses and carts also participating. The painting uses brushwork typical of early 19th-century illustrations, with clear outlines and flat areas of color in green, yellow, blue, and earth tones. In the background, crowds are gathered around tents and a stand. The sky is depicted with pastel hues and stylized, curvilinear clouds.

artworks.title: Place de Meir at Antwerp
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling market scene from a street-level point of view. The horizon line is low and there are pedestrians going about their day. A fountain or statue is on the right side, with detailed architecture, including a church with a steeple on the left. The painting style is detailed with clear textures and architectural elements. The color palette is warm with earthy tones dominating. Market vendors and townsfolk are interacting lively with carts and goods, adding movement. The buildings continue into the distance with less detail.

artworks.title: Limbs of the Law
artworks.description: The image depicts a cartoon of two men standing side by side. The man on the left has a round face, small round eyeglasses, white curly hair, and is dressed in a dark robe and coat. He holds a piece of paper. The man on the right has a prominent nose, white curly hair partly covered by a hat, and wears a dark suit with a long coat. He holds a cloth bag. The background shows a simple landscape. Text above them reads, "Oh! I perceive it at the first glance, We shall carry the cause hollow!!" and "You'll see the mistake very clearly. – I think it will do!!" "Limbs of the Law!!" is written above their feet.
